Let me write a cleaner version.Compiles cleanly (`COMPILE_OK`). The improved test keeps identical behavior — `EnumUtils.generateBitVectors(Object.class, emptyList)` still expected to throw `IllegalArgumentException` — while removing the unused imports and dead helper method, renaming variables to express intent, and documenting *why* raw types are necessary.
